# Vendored: bootstrap-combobox

Source: https://github.com/berrnd/bootstrap-combobox (fork of danielfarrell/bootstrap-combobox)
Commit: fcf0110146f4daab94888234c57d198b4ca5f129 (version 1.1.8)
License: Apache-2.0

Vendored because the upstream `master` branch was renamed to `master-fork`, leaving this commit
unreachable by any ref and breaking `yarn install`. Only the files Grocy needs are kept.
Installed into `public/packages/@danielfarrell/bootstrap-combobox` via the `file:` dependency in package.json.
